in_marathi.name: Sitesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sitesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sitesh is a Hindu name that is derived from Sanskrit language. It is a compound name composed of two words - 'Sita' and 'Ish', where Sita means fortune and Ish means Lord. The name Sitesh thus means 'Lord of Fortune'. It is a name that signifies wisdom, intelligence, and good luck.
